player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the task by issuing "DONE" upon returning to the Game room, failing to realize that the "west" direction from the Game room had not yet been explored. My strategy of stopping immediately upon revisiting a room was flawed because it ignored untried exits in previously visited locations. Next time, I will maintain a mental log of which directions have been attempted from each specific room. I will only issue "DONE" when I am in a room and have exhausted all available directions (i.e., every direction leads to a room I have already visited and fully explored). Specifically, upon returning to the Game room, I must check if "west" has been tried; if not, I will execute "GO: west" before considering the task complete.
